items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: And he gave me the fatherly advice, the do's and the don't because my father -- I didn't know a father, because when I was -- my father deserted us when I was six years old in Memphis

ctx.x: Well, he was just like a father down through the years with me. Because I used to call him regularly, and then I'd go over and visit with him, and any time I was playing someplace he would want to come, and he would come to catch us and all of that.

And he gave me the fatherly advice, the do's and the don't because my father -- I didn't know a father, because when I was -- my father deserted us when I was six years old in Memphis, and he left, and I really didn't know a father after that. But one of the closest things to a father to me was Mr. Elgar.
Yeah, and I have a tape that we taped on him, and I have tapes on him.
